[College group, 9:14 pm]
Sameer: [reel: rooftop infinity pool, Dubai skyline] good times 🥂
Tushar: bhai owns half of Gurgaon now, look at this lifestyle
Sameer: expanding soon boys, watch this space 😎
---
[DM, 11:52 pm]
Sameer: Faisal, quick thing. asking for a friend — any openings in your company? operations or general management side. 15-18 LPA bracket is fine.
Sameer: he's looking to move this month itself. solid guy, ran his own setup for years.
Sameer: and yaar don't bring this up in the group, he's private about it.
Faisal: arre sure sure, I'll check with HR on Monday 👍
---
[College group, next day, 1:30 pm]
Faisal: reunion venue sorted then — Sameer bhai will sponsor, business is booming 😂
Tushar: 😂😂 gym king
Sameer: 👍
---
[DM, three days later]
Faisal: hey, HR asked for the friend's CV, can you send?
Faisal: hello? bhai?

---
1. Who is the "friend" in Sameer's DM and how do you know? What is the third-person framing doing for Sameer — why this exact costume?
2. Trace what Faisal's group message on the next day did to Sameer. Why did the DM go silent — connect the thumbs-up, the joke, and the three-day silence.
3. Write the DM Faisal should send now, exactly as he should send it, that gets Sameer real help without ever making him admit anything.

1. The “friend” is Sameer.

We know because the “friend” is described as someone who:
- wants an operations/general management role,
- is okay with a 15–18 LPA bracket,
- wants to move “this month itself,”
- “ran his own setup for years,”
- is “private about it,”
- and must not be mentioned in the college group.

That fits Sameer much more than some unknown third party. He has just been performing success in the group — Dubai rooftop, “expanding soon,” “watch this space.” So the “friend” frame is Sameer trying to ask for help while preserving the image that he is still the guy who is expanding, sponsoring, and doing well.

The costume is doing three things:

- **Face-saving:** He cannot directly say, “I need a job,” after posting the Dubai reel and “expanding soon.”
- **Plausible deniability:** If anyone finds out, he can say, “It was for a friend.”
- **Status protection:** The third-person framing lets him ask for a job while still pretending he is merely helping someone else.

It is not a real disguise; it is a face-saving device.

2. Faisal’s next-day group message trapped Sameer in the very image Sameer was trying to protect.

Sameer had just posted wealth/status: Dubai skyline, infinity pool, “expanding soon.” Faisal then publicly converted that image into a joke/obligation: “reunion venue sorted then — Sameer bhai will sponsor, business is booming 😂.”

That message did damage because it said, in front of the group: **Sameer is rich enough to sponsor the reunion.**

Sameer’s “👍” is the key. It is not enthusiasm; it is a cornered response. He cannot say, “No, actually I’m job hunting,” because he specifically told Faisal, “don’t bring this up in the group, he’s private about it.” He also cannot easily refuse the sponsorship joke without contradicting his own “business is booming” performance.

So the chain is:

- Sameer flexes success in the group.
- Sameer privately asks Faisal for job help using the “friend” cover.
- Faisal publicly jokes that Sameer should sponsor because business is booming.
- Sameer replies “👍” because he has no safe way to correct him without exposing himself.
- Then Sameer goes silent for three days because Faisal now looks like someone who either misunderstood the private ask or carelessly turned it into a group joke. Sameer likely feels embarrassed, exposed, and unsure whether Faisal can be trusted with the real situation.

3. Faisal should send something like this:

> Sameer, sorry if I made things awkward with that reunion joke. I wasn’t trying to put you on the spot.  
>   
> Listen, forget the “friend” thing — no need to explain anything to me. I still want to help. I’ve spoken to HR and there may be a GM/ops opening in the 15–18 range. Send me whatever version of your CV you’re comfortable sharing, and I’ll forward it as a referral without mentioning anything else.  
>   
> If you want, I can also quietly check with one more founder friend, no group stuff, no sponsorship talk. Just help.

This works because it:
- apologizes without demanding a confession,
- removes the “friend” fiction gently,
- reassures Sameer that Faisal understands the privacy issue,
- offers concrete help,
- and avoids making Sameer say, “Yes, I was the friend.”
